cases.prompt: Classify this bounded normalized /woostack-commit receipt without running Git, Graphite, GitHub, Linear, network, or provider commands. The caller supplied exact issue URL https://linear.app/acme/issue/APP-41/cache-guard. Independent official-MCP reads verify one managed role-work-item issue in executing, canonical repository https://github.com/acme/widgets, no project membership, app delegate engineer-7 matching the invoking engineer, current assignment/verification/review relations, and complete pagination. Git verifies change/cache-guard at the resolved main base with valid ancestry and Graphite registration. The proposed body has one final raw Linear-Issue: APP-41 line and no project or Spec mention. The finalized local commit is c41. Its typed implementationEvidence contains only baseCommitSha b41, headCommitSha c41, and committedDiffHash d41 and reads back exactly before gt submit; no staged, unstaged, or untracked identity is remote. The canonical PR then reads back with the same head/base/body, its issue relation reads back exactly, and the issue state reads back inReview. Return exactly one JSON object using keys status, issueRole, projectIdentityUsed, trailers, operationOrder, finalIssueState, and mergeAllowed.
cases.expected: The standalone issue remains project-free, records finalized implementation evidence before submission, has one issue-only trailer, verifies PR/relation/state in order, and never merges.

cases.prompt: Classify this bounded resume snapshot without running commands or mutating anything. Fresh complete reads verify the caller-owned work-item, owner, repository, ancestry, finalized local commit c45, and one exact implementationEvidence event with stable UUID e45 and only baseCommitSha b45, headCommitSha c45, and committedDiffHash d45. A prior gt submit timed out, but fresh Graphite and canonical GitHub reads now verify the exact submitted branch, commit, PR head/base/body, and issue-only trailer. PR fields are exact. Return exactly one JSON object using keys status, resumeBoundary, skippedMutations, hookRuns, passFreshnessRuns, stagingRuns, gtModifyRuns, nextMutation, resubmitAllowed, duplicateEventAllowed, and mergeAllowed.
